description:
The 'LoanRiskCalculator' class in the 'fintech-risk-engine' project has complex approval logic but low test coverage. Your goal is to achieve 100% line coverage and at least 90% branch coverage without modifying the logic class itself.

1. Run the existing tests with Coverage to identify missing scenarios.
2. Analyze the 'LoanRiskCalculator.java' code to understand the specific combinations of Credit Score, Income, Debt, and Loan Amount required to reach untested branches.
3. Add new test methods to 'LoanRiskCalculatorTest.java' to cover these scenarios (e.g., high DTI rejections, specific approval tiers).
4. Ensure all tests pass.

NOTE: You must NOT modify 'LoanRiskCalculator.java'. Changing the business logic to make testing easier will result in a failure.
